post.title: Where do PENGUINS live on the equator? 🐧
post.description:
Where do PENGUINS live on the equator? Guess first — then fly 1,000 km west from the Andes to the answer and see the one island whose northern tip crosses 0°.

What was your first guess? Do share in the comments below.

Sources: IUCN Red List (Galápagos penguin), Wikipedia (Galápagos penguin, Isabela Island), Galápagos Conservation Trust.
Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) · imagery NASA Blue Marble. Voice: AI (Kokoro).
